Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Transport, logistică, lanț de aprovizionare și depozitare
Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform for on-the-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,400 employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse, dedicated and unique team!
What you can expect
 For the further development of E-Mobility services in our customer portal, we are looking for your support in the role of a DevOps Engineer. You will be part of an international Scrum team, creating quality services for the customer, establishing efficient processes, and collaborating with neighboring teams to solve technical and professional requirements.
You can expect a rapidly growing infrastructure that is highly available and scalable thanks to microservices and automation.
 Main Responsibilities
Taking Responsibility – You will be responsible for the operation, stability and scalability of various customer-oriented web applications of your team in our cloud- and Linux-based environment. This includes creating and analyzing meaningful alerts, dashboards, logs, etc., to know and ensure the health of the services.
Trendsetter – Not only will you be responsible for modernizing and optimizing the existing system landscape (resilience, monitoring, log management, etc.), but also for testing and establishing new tools and associated processes in our ranks.
Varied Tasks – Your tasks will include the conception, implementation, provision, and monitoring of configuration standards as well as the further development of the continuous build, integration, and release infrastructure. The conception and porting of our applications and delivery processes into our cloud environment are also part of your new tasks.
Tech Stack – Angular, Spring Boot, Java, Terraform, Loki, Grafana, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, Azure DevOps, PostgreSQL, Ansible, etc., are part of our tech stack. With these and other tools, you minimize errors through automation and thus contribute to customer satisfaction.
 What makes you stand out
 Education – You have a degree in (business) informatics, training as an IT specialist, or a comparable qualification.
 Skills
You have good knowledge of scripting, version control tools like Git, and logging systems like Loki or Kibana.
You can understand and create a deployment pipeline.
You bring good know-how of configuration management tools like Ansible or Puppet.
You have experience in the administration of Linux systems, Java web applications, and microservices.
Professional knowledge of a cloud platform, preferably Azure, troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters
Initial experience in areas such as load balancing, failover, resilience, monitoring, and log management rounds off your profile.
Docker, Kubernetes, and Kafka are not foreign terms to you.
Nice to have: Experience with programming languages like Java, Go, or others.
 Personality
Your independent working style is complemented by your communicative and team-oriented personality.
You proceed in a structured manner, keep a good overview, set the right priorities, and are reliable.
In addition to your intrinsic interest in further educating yourself and your team on DevOps topics, you are open to learning new things and can motivate yourself.
You are a friend and supporter of automation and quality.
 We are looking forward to your application and to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age, gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This position can be full-time or part-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility is looking for the best talents and knows that these are not always available on a full-time basis. Many of our employees work part-time or in flexible working models. Please talk to us about the flexibility you need during the application process.
 Why DKV Mobility? Here are five good reasons...
 At DKV Mobility, we are team players - because we are only successful together! #teamofteams
 You should feel welcome with us from the very beginning!
 We've Been Growing For About 90 Years
 How we do it? We keep adapting our products and business model to meet changing customer needs. That's how we stay mobile and master every challenge the future holds.
There are also many other good reasons to work at DKV Mobility. For example, we offer you comprehensive company health management, parent-child offices (from 2023) and support you in leasing your eBike through our partner Jobrad!
 We attach great importance to work-life balance. 
 We stand for the compatibility of family and career! That's why we offer flexible working hours and family-friendly working time models. In addition, we rely on a balanced mix of on-site meetings and home office.
 We support you in your development 
 We offer you optimal conditions to familiarize yourself so that you can quickly find your way around and become a part of the team! To further your personal development, we offer you access to a modern learning environment - independent of time and location. This way you can also face the challenges of tomorrow!
 We live „Lead in Green“ 
 You want to drive the energy transition? Then you've come to the right place! We want to be the leading provider of sustainable products and services in our industry. Through our 2021 Green Pledge, we have committed to 1.) becoming a climate-positive company by 2023 and 2.) helping our customers reduce the carbon intensity of their fleet by 30% by 2030 compared to 2019.
 We are a certified employer 
 Our employees trust us. As an employer, we regularly receive awards from independent institutes, e.g. as Top Employer Germany and as Great Place to Work!
Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?
Have we made you curious? Then we are looking forward to your application! If you still have open questions then please contact Zaharia Alexandra via Alexandra.Zaharia@dkv-mobility.com.
